container.description: exec mode: existing container to exec in (default: the labeled container)

image.description: run mode: image for a fresh one-shot container (instead of exec-ing an existing one)

user.description: User to run the command as

env.description: Extra environment variables; values support ${ENV} expansion

network.description: run mode: Docker network to attach the one-shot container to

volumes.description: run mode: mounts as source:/target[:ro] (source = volume name or host path)

timeout.description: Optional hook timeout as a Go duration (e.g. 5m); empty = no timeout

last.description: Keep the N most recent snapshots

within.description: Keep all snapshots within a duration (restic --keep-within

repo.description: Repository name (the {app} in a target template); default: compose service/container name

auto.description: Include the labeled container's own mounts as sources (default: true)

extraVolumes.description: Extra named volumes to include on top of the auto-discovered set

excludeVolumes.description: Named volumes to drop from the auto-discovered set (auto: true); does not affect the explicit extraVolumes list or file-level exclude patterns

extraPaths.description: Extra host paths (bind mounts) to include

tags.description: Extra restic tags added to each snapshot

targets.description: Targets to back up to; each entry is a target name or an object with a name plus per-target overrides. Default: all configured targets

stop.description: Stop the labeled container during the backup and restart it afterwards

preHooks.description: Commands to exec before the backup

postHooks.description: Commands to exec after the backup

timeout.description: Per-app backup timeout as a Go duration (e.g. 2h); empty uses the global default

user.description: uid[:gid] the mover runs as for this app; overrides SABON_MOVER_USER

groups.description: Extra supplementary groups (GIDs) added to the mover; overrides SABON_MOVER_GROUPS

snapshot.description: Source snapshot strategy: none | zfs | auto (auto snapshots ZFS sources and mounts the rest live); overrides SABON_SNAPSHOT

excludeVolumes.description: Named volumes not backed up to this target

excludePaths.description: Host bind paths not backed up to this target

exclude.description: Extra restic --exclude patterns for this target
